name: voice
description: Talk to Atlas by voice: the audio you send, in the app or on Telegram, written down before the model reads it.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Your OpenAI API key, the one Atlas's OpenAI provider uses: speech is written down by OpenAI's transcription model.

settings.name: transcription_model
settings.description: OpenAI's model that writes down what an audio file says.

settings.name: api_url
settings.description: OpenAI's API address; another one only for a compatible server, or for tests.
